title: Feet of Clay

The situation escalates into a conflict between Dillon's actions and the authority of the priesthood, culminating in a dramatic confrontation over cultural beliefs and the consequences of his meddling in their society. Ultimately, the story offers a poignant reflection on the complexities of faith, power dynamics, and the ethical dilemmas faced when one tries to provide help in a context they do not fully understand.
